notes: NovaShell’s local control layer keeps getting more accountable: Relay now explains what each AI route can actually do, the live Project Board stays current without a refresh, and local-first boundaries remain explicit.
changes: Relay now shows each provider route’s best use, free-tier or account limits, data boundary, and the difference between drafting and the separately confirmed Local Codex runner.
Project Board is a live one-way Relay build chat that polls the local feed every 1.2 seconds, so task moves and implementation notes arrive without a reload.
Live system card continues to show local OS, controller state, memory, storage, and load before opening deeper activity details.
Utility Desk adds a no-network workspace handoff manifest for folder inventories and SHA-256 fingerprints.
Pocket Archive public captures use a true low-resolution pixel mosaic instead of a blur, while local owners keep their original artwork.
Settings includes Chromebook-aware system and access guidance, with new assets cached for offline PWA use.
